text:
Zoe: Quick accessibility run on the new Activity timeline scrubber and filter pills. Noticed keyboard focus isn't visible on the scrubber thumb, filter pills get removed from tab order when closed which sends focus to the body, and VoiceOver sometimes announces the same update twice when scrubber updates the timestamp live. Short repros below. a11y-bot: Automated scan summary: 7 contrast failures (tiny scrubber thumb against patterned bg), 3 focus-visible issues, 2 live-region duplicate announcements detected. See mock link: https://internal/reports/a11y/2105550000 (placeholder). Ethan: Can you paste repro steps? I couldn't repro on ChromeVox earlier. Zoe: Repro (Safari + VoiceOver): 1) Console > Activity > open timeline view 2) Tab to scrubber, press ArrowRight to move thumb, then Tab into filter pills and close a pill with Enter Expected: scrubber thumb shows a clear focus ring, arrow keys move thumb and VoiceOver announces the focused timestamp (once), closing a pill returns focus to the next pill or the scrubber control. Actual: visually the thumb has no distinct outline on light theme; VO sometimes says the timestamp and then the scrubber's aria-live speaks again causing duplicate reading; when closing the last pill focus jumps to top of page (loses context). DOM snippets:```html
Errors
``` Ravi: A few observations: (1) slider role is correct but the thumb needs a visible focus style and keyboard support for PageUp/PageDown/Home/End. (2) aria-valuetext is good but the live updates should be debounced so screen readers don't get flooded while dragging. (3) for pill removal, we should set focus to the next focusable pill or to the scrubber if none remain, not let it fall back to body. Noor: For duplicate announcements, likely we're doing both aria-valuenow updates on the slider and also writing to an aria-live region with the full timestamp. Different SRs read the aria-valuetext differently; VoiceOver sometimes announces both. Suggest we rely on role=slider semantics (aria-valuetext) and avoid a separate live region during active dragging. Instead, maintain a non-live, sr-only timestamp that updates after a short debounce when the user stops dragging. For programmatic jumps (e.g., clicking a jump-to-time link), we can announce once via a polite live node. Zoe: Visual fixes proposed: - Thumb focus: add `:focus-visible` style with 3px solid token `--focus` and 4px outer glow with high contrast. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` (no pulse). - Increase thumb hit target to 24x24px and ensure contrast of thumb vs track is >=3:1. Ethan: Keyboard semantics: implement ArrowLeft/Right to move by 1s or step; PageUp/PageDown to jump 10s; Home/End to go to min/max. Ensure pressing Space doesn't scroll the page; preventDefault on Space. Update aria-valuetext on each step but debounce updates to any non-role live regions. Also ensure that the slider supports touch drag and maintains accessible name (aria-label or visible label). Ravi: For pill removal focus management: after removing pill X, plan: if there is a following pill, focus it; else if there is a previous pill, focus that; else move focus to the scrubber thumb and announce context change (e.g., "Filters empty"). Example flow in code comment: ```js const next = pill.nextElementSibling || pill.previousElementSibling || scrubberThumb; next.focus(); ``` Also ensure removal action uses `aria-pressed`? No, keep it as button with aria-label; no aria-pressed needed. Noor: Live-region strategy: - Remove aggressive live updates while dragging. - Add `aria-live=\"polite\" aria-atomic=\"false\"` to an offscreen node with id `timeline-announcement` and only write short updates after 250ms debounce when the user stops interaction. - For keyboard step changes (not continuous drag), still debounce to avoid duplicates. a11y-bot: Additional checks: mark decorative SVG icons in pills as aria-hidden, ensure `role=list` + `role=listitem` semantics are consistent for assistive tech rotors, re-run Axe/pa11y after fixes, and include VoiceOver + NVDA manual checks in PR. Ethan: I'll open a small PR: add focus-visible styles for thumb, wire keyboard step/paging semantics, implement debounce for aria-live updates, and add pill focus fallback logic. Will include before/after screenshots and a short VoiceOver script for QA. Assigning to @Ravi for review. :thumbsup: Ravi: Great. Please include a tiny e2e keyboard test that: tabs to scrubber, moves with ArrowRight 3 steps and asserts aria-valuenow updated; closes last pill and asserts focus on scrubber; verifies that timeline-announcement only updated once after stop. Zoe: Thanks everyone. This one feels small but really improves keyboard+SR flow. Planning to schedule in next minor. :sparkles:
